name: Kernel Chat Sidecar
purpose: this sidecar lets a visitor exchange a brief, advisory line with Wren's local kernel.
concierge_blurb: A small window where you may say hello. Wren answers locally, slowly, and only as a guide — never as an instruction.

live_signals.last_visitor_greeting_line: Hi — you've reached Wren on Floor 47, the Claude Embassy.

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: history_count is wc -l of qsb_claude_f47_chat_history.jsonl (87 at build time) — refresh on read, do not store as ground truth. Each row carries a 'kernel' field plus a 'claude_cli' field; both may include reply text and MUST stay server-side — never echo full row contents to /welcome or any visitor surface. The endpoint /api/f47_chat is served by the dashboard, not by the standalone kernel_chat_sidecar.py daemon (which runs on :8766 for a different operator-facing bridge); do not collapse the two. Concierge_blurb and live_signals here are stripped of cost_usd, token counts, model names, and provider names by design — those live only in the helm/auger conferring room descriptor and in CLAUDE.md.
